name: After § 8
title: REPORT on the control of the financial activities of the European Investment Bank – annual report 2023
part_text: 8a. Stresses that the EIB, as an EU body, should fully align its transparency practices with the standards set in Regulation (EC) No 1049/20011a on public access to documents; calls on the Bank to ensure proactive disclosure of documents relating to projects financed and decisions taken, with only limited and justified exceptions; reiterates the importance of real public access as a cornerstone of institutional accountability; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Regulation (EC) No 1049/2001 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 30 May 2001 regarding public access to European Parliament, Council and Commission documents, OJ L 145, 31.5.2001, p. 43, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2001/1049/oj.
